text: This report provides an update on the outcomes of a one-year pilot for a community mediation referral program to support By-law complaints that arise from disputes between neighbours. The program was established in the summer of 2018 as a partnership between the City's Municipal Licensing and Standards (MLS) division and St. Stephen's Community House. Noise, right of entry applications, and fences were chosen as areas of focus for the pilot program; these issues often involve disputes between neighbours where the two parties have an interest in maintaining or repairing their relationship. The one-year pilot program has demonstrated positive outcomes and this report recommends that the program continue and be expanded within MLS.
